intro: Adjectives that change meaning with their position, and what putting an adjective first does to a sentence.
p.viejo.consejo: «Un viejo amigo» is a friend of many years; «un amigo viejo» is an elderly friend.
p.pobre.consejo: «Un hombre pobre» has no money; «un pobre hombre» is a pitiable man.
p.grande.consejo: Before a singular noun it loses «de»: «un gran día». After it, «un hombre grande» is a big man.
p.nuevo.consejo: «Mi nuevo coche» is the latest I have; «mi coche nuevo» is brand new.
p.antiguo.consejo: Before the noun it means «former»: «mi antiguo jefe». After it, it is old: «un piso antiguo».
p.único.consejo: «Mi única hija» is the only daughter; «una hija única» has no siblings.
p.cierto.consejo: Before the noun it is «some»: «cierta información». After it, it is true: «información cierta».
p.simple.consejo: «Un simple camarero» is just a waiter; «un camarero simple» is not very bright.
p.mismo.consejo: «El mismo director» is the director from before; «el director mismo» is him in person.
p.puro.consejo: «Pura casualidad» is mere chance; «agua pura» has no mixture.
p.rojizo.consejo: The suffix «-izo» gives an approximate colour: rojo → rojizo. It goes after the noun.
p.matiz.consejo: Its plural is «matices». It ends in z, which sounds «th»: ma-TITH.
b1.texto:
The normal place of a Spanish adjective is **after** the noun, and there it **distinguishes**: **un coche rojo** is red and not another colour.

**Before** the noun, an adjective does not distinguish. It **comments**: it adds an evaluation or something already known. That is why it sounds literary or emphatic: **un grave problema**, **la blanca nieve**, **una magnífica idea**.

Some adjectives must go after: those of nationality, colour, shape and type. You say **un producto lácteo**, **una chica francesa**, never the other way round.

A small group has two meanings. Before the noun the meaning is subjective, after it literal.
b2.f0.texto: What is the difference between a viejo amigo and an amigo viejo?
b2.f1.texto: A viejo amigo is a friend of many years.
b2.f2.texto: An amigo viejo is a friend of advanced age.
b2.f3.texto: So a hombre pobre has no money.
b2.f4.texto: A pobre hombre is a pitiable man.
b2.f5.texto: I am an only child, but I have a great friend.
b2.f6.texto: Before the noun, cierta means some.
b2.f7.texto: Simple, mismo and puro also change.
b2.f8.texto: The nuances are small, but they change the meaning.
b2.f9.texto: A reddish sky is not a red sky.
b4.texto:
- un **viejo** amigo (of many years) / un amigo **viejo** (elderly)
- un **pobre** hombre (unfortunate) / un hombre **pobre** (with no money)
- un **gran** hombre (a great man) / un hombre **grande** (a big man)
- mi **nuevo** coche (my latest) / mi coche **nuevo** (brand new)
- mi **antiguo** piso (my former) / un piso **antiguo** (an old flat)
- mi **única** hija (my only) / una hija **única** (an only child)
- **cierta** información (some) / información **cierta** (true)
- un **simple** camarero (a mere waiter) / un camarero **simple** (simple-minded)
- el **mismo** director (the same) / el director **mismo** (himself)

**Grande** becomes gran before a singular noun: un gran día. Approximate colours take a suffix and go after: rojo → **rojizo**, amarillo → **amarillento**, azul → **azulado**, verde → **verdoso**.

An adjective can also describe the subject through the verb: Ana llegó cansada. It agrees with the subject.
b4.e0.texto: My former flat was an old flat.
b4.e1.texto: I found out by sheer chance.
b5.f0.texto: A reddish sky rests on the rooftops of the village.
b5.f1.texto: Along the road comes an old friend of the family with a small suitcase.
b5.f2.texto: His hands, tired and tanned, hold a great wooden box.
b5.f3.texto: The man smiles with a mere nod of the head.
b5.f4.texto: Behind him, the valley turns yellowish under the last light.
b5.f5.texto: The door of the house opens without a sound, as if the air itself pushed it.
b5.f6.texto: Inside, an old lamp casts a greenish circle on the wall.
b5.f7.texto: Out of sheer habit, the guest leaves his hat on the same nail as always.
b5.f8.texto: The woman of the house offers him a hot tea and a piece of bread.
b5.f9.texto: There is no longer any trace of tiredness on his face.
b6.o1: un profesor de edad muy avanzada
b6.o1.refuerzo: That would be «un profesor antiguo», with the adjective after.
b6.o2.refuerzo: No: nothing in the sentence speaks of a museum.
b7.o0.refuerzo: Yes: «grande» shortens to «gran» before a singular noun.
b7.o1.refuerzo: Before a singular noun it shortens: «un gran escritor».
b7.o2.refuerzo: It is plural, but «escritor» is singular.
b7.pregunta: Choose the form before a singular noun.
b8.frase: Es un viejo amigo de la familia
b8.traduccion: He is an old friend of the family
b9.o0.refuerzo: Yes: after the noun, «pobre» is literal.
b9.pregunta: Which sentence says he has no money?
b10.pregunta: Write with the accent mark: «my only problem».
b11.o0.refuerzo: Yes: it agrees with «los niños», masculine plural.
b11.o1.refuerzo: It is singular and does not agree with «los niños».
b11.o2.refuerzo: It is an adverb; Spanish uses the adjective here.
b11.pregunta: The adjective agrees with the subject.
b12.o0.refuerzo: That would be «es mi única hija», with the adjective first.
b12.o1.refuerzo: Well done: after the noun, «única» means without siblings.
b12.o2.refuerzo: Here «única» does not speak of being special.
p.diferencia.consejo: Feminine, «la diferencia». The c before i is th, and the ia is a diphthong.
p.avanzada.consejo: Feminine of «avanzado». The v sounds like b and the z like th.
p.única.consejo: Feminine of «único», only. Stress on U: U-ni-ka.
p.cierta.consejo: Feminine of «cierto». The c before i is th: THYER-ta.
p.cambian.consejo: From «cambiar», to change. The ia is a diphthong: KAM-byan.
p.matices.consejo: Plural of «matiz», nuance. The z is th in Spain: ma-TI-thes.
p.sentido.consejo: Masculine, «el sentido». Stress on TI: sen-TI-do.
p.morenas.consejo: Feminine plural of «moreno», tanned or dark. Stress on RE.
p.sostienen.consejo: From «sostener», to hold up. The ie is a diphthong: sos-TIE-nen.
p.inclinación.consejo: Feminine, «la inclinación». The -ción ending takes the stress.
p.amarillento.consejo: Ends in -ento. The ll and y are one sound; the ie is a diphthong: a-ma-ri-YEN-to.
p.empujara.consejo: Subjunctive of «empujar», to push. The j sounds like h.
p.proyecta.consejo: From «proyectar», to project. The x sounds ks and the y sounds like y.
p.verdoso.consejo: The v sounds like b. Stress on DO: ber-DO-so.
p.clavo.consejo: Masculine, «el clavo». Stress on KLA: KLA-bo.
p.cervantes.consejo: A famous Spanish writer, the author of «Don Quijote». Stress on BAN.
